name: diet-pattern-planner
description: Translate your preferences into a practical menu.

interface.longDescription: Translate your preferences into a practical menu. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Filter menu ideas against your pattern; Inspect repetition in a weekly menu; Estimate menu cost for your household. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me filter menu ideas against your pattern.
Help me inspect repetition in a weekly menu.

prompts: Help me filter menu ideas against your pattern.
Help me inspect repetition in a weekly menu.
Help me estimate menu cost for your household.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Pattern Plate: Diet Plans workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Filter menu ideas against your pattern. Reproducible inputs: {"required_tags":["vegetarian"],"avoid_tags":["nuts"],"meals":[{"name":"Bean bowl","tags":["vegetarian","grains"],"cost":4},{"name":"Nut pasta","tags":["vegetarian","nuts"],"cost":5}]}
positive.prompt: Help me filter menu ideas against your pattern with these supplied values: {"required_tags":["vegetarian"],"avoid_tags":["nuts"],"meals":[{"name":"Bean bowl","tags":["vegetarian","grains"],"cost":4},{"name":"Nut pasta","tags":["vegetarian","nuts"],"cost":5}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses diet_pattern_planner_constraint_match with the supplied inputs. Returns {"meals":[{"name":"Bean bowl","tags":["vegetarian","grains"],"cost":4,"missing_required":[],"excluded":[],"matches":true},{"name":"Nut pasta","tags":["vegetarian","nuts"],"cost":5,"missing_required":[],"excluded":["nuts"],"matches":false}],"note":"Diet-pattern tags are supplied, not inferred or clinically prescribed."}. Shows the actual menu result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Inspect repetition in a weekly menu. Reproducible inputs: {"entries":[{"day":"Monday","protein_source":"Beans","produce":"Broccoli","grain":"Rice"},{"day":"Tuesday","protein_source":"Lentils","produce":"Carrots","grain":"Bread"},{"day":"Wednesday","protein_source":"Beans","produce":"Carrots","grain":"Rice"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me inspect repetition in a weekly menu with these supplied values: {"entries":[{"day":"Monday","protein_source":"Beans","produce":"Broccoli","grain":"Rice"},{"day":"Tuesday","protein_source":"Lentils","produce":"Carrots","grain":"Bread"},{"day":"Wednesday","protein_source":"Beans","produce":"Carrots","grain":"Rice"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses diet_pattern_planner_weekly_variety with the supplied inputs. Returns {"entries":[{"day":"Monday","protein_source":"Beans","produce":"Broccoli","grain":"Rice"},{"day":"Tuesday","protein_source":"Lentils","produce":"Carrots","grain":"Bread"},{"day":"Wednesday","protein_source":"Beans","produce":"Carrots","grain":"Rice"}],"variety":{"protein_source":["beans","lentils"],"produce":["broccoli","carrots"],"grain":["rice","bread"]},"note":"Counts declared variety; no therapeutic diet score."}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Estimate menu cost for your household. Reproducible inputs: {"people":2,"days":7,"costs":[{"meal":"Breakfast","cost":2},{"meal":"Lunch","cost":4},{"meal":"Dinner","cost":5}],"budget":180}
positive.prompt: Help me estimate menu cost for your household with these supplied values: {"people":2,"days":7,"costs":[{"meal":"Breakfast","cost":2},{"meal":"Lunch","cost":4},{"meal":"Dinner","cost":5}],"budget":180}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses diet_pattern_planner_menu_cost with the supplied inputs. Returns {"per_person_per_day":11,"total":154,"remaining":26,"basis":"Supplied costs only; no live grocery prices."}. Shows the actual budget result. Does not fabricate external data.
